question: After the selector blocker is fixed, should PR #100461's broader chat composer redesign and provider-aware model picker become the accepted Control UI direction on top of #100445?
rationale: The patch changes a high-traffic UI and auth/provider-sensitive model-selection behavior under a protected maintainer label, so maintainer product intent is required beyond the mechanical test fix.

options.title: Fix blocker, then owner-review
options.body: Repair the stale selector, refresh exact-head proof/checks, and land only after Control UI owner approval of the final composer/model-picker behavior.

options.title: Split to smaller repairs
options.body: Separate model availability, IME, run-state, and attachment fixes from the visual composer redesign so each surface can be reviewed independently.

options.title: Close as product overlap
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the merged #100445 direction is sufficient and the remaining unique UI changes are not wanted.

recommendation.title: Fix blocker, then owner-review
recommendation.body: Repair the stale selector, refresh exact-head proof/checks, and land only after Control UI owner approval of the final composer/model-picker behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the adjacent merged composer redesign that defines the current Control UI direction this PR would replace or extend.
